\n**How to get your Buffer API key:**\n\:
**How to get your Buffer API key:**

1. Sign in to Buffer and open **Settings → API** (https://publish.buffer.com/settings/api).
2. Click **Create key**, give it a name, and copy the key. Buffer shows it only once.
3. Paste it below.

The key acts as you: it reaches every organization and channel on your Buffer account. All your keys and MCP connections share one request limit (Free plan: 150 requests per 15 minutes and 600 per day).

Triggers when a new channel is connected: Triggers when a new channel is connected to your Buffer organization. Each check uses one Buffer API request, which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day).
Triggers when a new post is queued in Bu: Triggers when a new post is queued in Buffer. Each check usually uses one Buffer API request (one more per 100 matching posts, at most 10 per check; any left over are picked up on the next check), which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day).
Triggers when a Buffer post is successfu: Triggers when a Buffer post is successfully published. Each check usually uses one Buffer API request (one more per 100 posts sent in the last 24 hours, at most 10 per check), which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day). If more than 1,000 posts are sent in one day, only the 1,000 with the latest scheduled times are checked.
